certifiedResults.metadataNotes: Parsed from the New Hampshire 2024 General Election President and Vice-President county summary PDF. The live New Hampshire Secretary of State results page lists the corresponding President of the United States Excel file; the pipeline uses this PDF copy because the SOS XLS endpoint is browser-protected from automated downloads in this environment.

turnout.notes: Turnout is not loaded in the baseline import because the national county results file does not include registered-voter denominators.

certifiedResults.title: New Hampshire official presidential county summary
certifiedResults.detail: County-level presidential rows are parsed from the State of New Hampshire 2024 General Election President and Vice-President summary by counties. The live SOS results page lists the matching President of the United States Excel file; the local pipeline uses the one-page PDF copy because direct automated XLS download is blocked.
certifiedResults.sourceTimestampBasis: Official New Hampshire 2024 General Election Results page lists President of the United States Excel; local PDF copy contains the same county summary and reconciles to its TOTALS row.

wardDetail.title: New Hampshire precinct or reporting-unit detail
wardDetail.detail: The loaded official presidential summary is county-level only. Review drilldowns need an official precinct, ward, town, or reporting-unit source before they can be enabled.
wardDetail.sourceTimestampBasis: Baseline source checked during broad state import.

turnout.title: New Hampshire turnout denominator
turnout.detail: The presidential county summary includes candidate votes plus under-votes and over-votes, but turnout remains disabled until an official registered-voter denominator is mapped.
turnout.sourceTimestampBasis: Baseline source lacks registered-voter denominator fields.

checkedNotUsable.reason: Useful for broad app coverage, but the repository itself notes that the compiled results are not authoritative. Promote this state to a native official source when possible.
checkedNotUsable.nextStep: Replaced for certified presidential county results; keep only as a historical fallback reference.

checkedNotUsable.category: New Hampshire SOS President Excel direct download
checkedNotUsable.reason: The official XLS endpoint returned an access-denied HTML page during automated pipeline collection. The state results page still lists this Excel file, and the local parser uses the matching county-summary PDF copy.
checkedNotUsable.nextStep: Replace the PDF copy with the native SOS XLS if a manual or browser-backed download is available.

turnoutPolicy.warning: New Hampshire turnout should not be inferred from the baseline county results file because it lacks registered-voter denominators.
